notes: Read benchmark is end-to-end client QueryPlan elapsed time; single-process single-worker.
All records are loaded through Stage 6 reference materializer; not a production TSBS loader.
The baseline uses the original TSBS series_id partition definition, without legacy COMPACT STORAGE.
Generated query instances match TSBS query template semantics but are not a replay of Go generator bytes.
All outputs are post-selection only: never reuse latency to modify activation, weights or HBench.
